title: Divide, and find what is left over
objective: Use divided by for an exact answer, divided evenly by for a whole number, and remainder of for what is left over.

body.text: Divided by gives the exact answer, which can be a decimal. divided evenly by gives only the whole number of times one value fits into another. remainder of gives what is left over after that.

body.title: Three ways to divide 17 by 5
body.code:
make exact equal to 17 divided by 5
say exact
make bags equal to 17 divided evenly by 5
say bags
make leftover equal to remainder of 17 and 5
say leftover

body.prompt: Seventeen cookies do not fill bags of five. The program prints the number of bags; it should print how many are left over instead. Make it print 2.
body.starter:
make leftover equal to 17 divided by 5
say leftover
body.solution:
make leftover equal to remainder of 17 and 5
say leftover
